einvoice.readyHint: No profile or bank issues on the sample check.

issues.DOC_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: E-invoices are not available for estimates. Fix the document type on the invoice.
issues.NOT_FINAL: Issue or finalize the invoice before export.
issues.NUMBER_MISSING: Add an invoice number on the invoice.
issues.CURRENCY_FRACTION_UNSUPPORTED: This currency uses more than two decimal places. Change the currency on the invoice.
issues.TAX_PER_LINE_REQUIRED: Switch to per-line tax and set a category on every row in Settings › Invoices › Tax rates.
issues.CATEGORY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Remove unsupported tax categories in Settings › Invoices › Tax rates.
issues.RATE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: Fix tax rate and category pairs in Settings › Invoices › Tax rates.
issues.OUT_OF_SCOPE_MIXED: Out-of-scope tax cannot be mixed with other categories.
issues.EXEMPTION_REASON_MISSING: Add exemption reasons in Settings › Invoices › Tax rates.
issues.SELLER_NAME_MISSING: Add a legal or company name in Settings › Profile.
issues.SELLER_ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: Complete the structured address in Settings › Profile › Address.
issues.SELLER_COUNTRY_MISSING: Add the country in Settings › Profile › Address.
issues.SELLER_TAX_ID_MISSING: Add a tax ID or VAT ID in Settings › Profile.
issues.SELLER_VAT_ID_REQUIRED: Add a VAT ID in Settings › Profile.
issues.BUYER_NAME_MISSING: Add the client name in Clients.
issues.BUYER_COUNTRY_MISSING: Add the client country in Clients › Address.
issues.BUYER_ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: Add the client postcode and city in Clients › Address.
issues.BUYER_VAT_ID_REQUIRED: Add a valid buyer VAT ID on the client.
issues.BUYER_VAT_ID_FORMAT: The client tax ID does not look like a VAT ID.
issues.DUE_DATE_MISSING: Add a due date on the invoice.
issues.PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_MISSING: Add a bank IBAN in Settings › Profile › Bank account.
issues.IBAN_INVALID: Fix the IBAN in Settings › Profile › Bank account.
issues.BIC_INVALID: Fix the BIC in Settings › Profile › Bank account.
issues.BUYER_REFERENCE_MISSING: Add a buyer reference (Leitweg-ID) on the client.
issues.BUYER_REFERENCE_OFF: XRechnung needs a buyer reference. Turn on Buyer Reference in the e-invoice settings, or use Factur-X.
issues.LEITWEG_CHECK_DIGITS: The Leitweg-ID check digits look wrong on the client.
issues.SELLER_CONTACT_INCOMPLETE: Add contact name, phone and email in Settings › Profile.
issues.ELECTRONIC_ADDRESS_MISSING: Add seller and buyer email addresses.
issues.CREDIT_NOTE_REFERENCE_MISSING: Link the credited invoice on the credit note.
issues.ARITHMETIC_MISMATCH: Invoice totals do not match EN 16931 rules. Review line tax and amounts.
